rule: Every boundary smoke probe needs a backend-ready fixture id, route, payload, expected policy result, and rollback note before production learning runs.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody fixture can pass shared-learning policy.
fixture_principles: Give every buyer, supplier, and founder boundary probe a stable audit fixture id.
Map each fixture to the API route that should accept or block it.
Name the payload so backend tests can assert the same policy behavior as the UI.
State the expected policy result before any recommendation weight changes.
Include a rollback note for every allowed shared-learning result.
Keep payment-custody, rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, and booking commission fixtures blocked.
acceptance: Marketplace shows the Boundary Audit Fixture Pack strip after Boundary Policy Smoke Console.
Buyer, supplier, and founder roles each show a fixture id, expected policy result, rollback state, and blocked payment route.
Build Phase shows the v166 Boundary Audit Fixture Pack contract after the v165 Boundary Policy Smoke Console contract.
Copy text exports every fixture id, route, payload, expected result, rollback note, and blocked payment route.
Docs include allowed fixture routes, blocked fixture routes, and required fixture fields.
Static checks protect the v166 cache token, UI ids, app functions, CSS selectors, and JSON model.
